pages.heading: Lecture 9 - Conditional probability
lines: Def: P(A|B) = P(A n B) / P(B), when P(B) > 0
read as: prob of A given B
Ex: roll a fair die. A = even, B = at least 4
Note: P(A|B) is not P(B|A) in general!

pages.heading: Multiplication rule
lines: Chain: P(A n B n C) = P(A) P(B|A) P(C|A n B)
(sketch: Venn diagram, A and B overlap)

pages.heading: Lecture 10 - Bayes' theorem
lines: P(Bj|A) = P(A|Bj) P(Bj) / sum of P(A|Bi) P(Bi)

pages.heading: Independence
lines: A, B independent iff P(A n B) = P(A) P(B)
Ex: two coin flips, H on 1st and H on 2nd are indep
